verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity supports webhook-driven automation ('automatically trigger reactions' on verification status changes) and programmatic access to results, plus an official MCP server letting AI agents call Stripe APIs. This enables event-driven automation but there's no evidence of scheduled/autonomous background agent workflows specific to Identity beyond webhook triggers and API access. Missing for 10: documented autonomous scheduling/orchestration features, evidence of AI agents independently managing verification lifecycles without human-defined webhook handlers, and hands-on confirmation of MCP-driven Identity automations.
